_help: Armory economy (Skillz). currency = Gravemark: persistent (Progress [armory]), separate from points, kept on death. Every source's amount or chance is multiplied by Difficulty.rare_currency_drop_mult() (easy 1.0, medium 1.35, hard 1.75); chances above 1 pay the whole part plus a roll for the rest. match_cap = most Gravemarks one match can pay. upgrades = per-archetype tiers bought in order; cost[tier-1] x archetype_cost_mult; item_power = TOTAL bonus at that tier added to the weapon's Item Power (damage x(1+IP*0.004)); mods = that tier's extra WeaponItem mods (they stack with lower tiers). expected = assumptions for Armory.expected_match_income() (tests + the matches-to-max table).

boss._help: BossCatalog gravemark_reward (2-3) for the first boss killed in a round; later bosses that round pay extra_boss_amount.

elite._help: zombie meta 'elite' = true, or a variant listed here (none yet; G4M3N's armored variants).

tiers.name: II
tiers.summary: +16 Item Power, reload -5%. Unlocks tier 2 attachments.

tiers.name: IV
tiers.summary: +38 Item Power, recoil -10%. Unlocks tier 3 attachments.

expected._help: Income model: kills = main.gd wave counts x Difficulty count mults; chest_opens_per_round; bosses killed as rostered.
